==About me==

''Hi everyone! I am an avid fan of the Wheel of Time and have been ever since my friend introduced me to the series when I was 10 years old. I love discussing and writing about WoT - hence my presence here! My favourite characters are Nynaeve and Mat, and I adore the superb world-building skills of Robert Jordan. Aside from WoT, my passions include environmental activism and general charity work. ''

''Dovie'andi se tovya sagain - It's time to toss the dice''
